command:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show xochitl -p MainPID --value)
printf 'PID %s\n' "$pid"
printf 'ADAPTER_MAP\n'
cat "/proc/$pid/maps" | grep 'pi-ink-loopback-0020.so'
if grep -q '/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/webserver-remote.so' "/proc/$pid/maps"; then echo 'CONFLICTING_ORIGINAL_STILL_MAPPED'; exit 2; fi
for p in /proc/$pid/fd/*; do target=$(readlink "$p" || true); case "$target" in socket:*) printf '%s %s\n' "$p" "$target";; esac; done
printf 'FIXED_MARKER_LOG_ONLY\n'
journalctl -u xochitl --since '3 minutes ago' --grep='PI_INK_LOOPBACK_0020|PiInkToolbar|pi-ink-bridge-0020' --no-pager
